title: 2027 Application Information for International Students (Master's Degree and Ph.D. Degree)
about: Peking University accepts applications from international students for 2027 master's and Ph.D. programs from October 26 to December 25, 2026 (Beijing time). Some schools and English-taught programs set their own deadlines.
requirements: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport
Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree; doctoral applicants need a master's degree (bachelor's holders may apply to science and engineering doctorates)
Personal statement with research plan (1,500 words for master's, 3,000 for doctoral), résumé, commitment letter and two recommendation letters
Up to two programs per applicant; non-refundable application fee of 800 RMB

upskill.name: Prompt Engineering for Research & Knowledge Work
why: "Personal statement with research plan (1,500 words for master's, 3,000 for doctoral)" → "Design prompts for reviewing literature, identifying themes, extracting research information, and comparing findings across multiple sources."
"Personal statement with research plan" → "Use iterative prompting workflows to move from broad exploration to focused analysis, synthesis, and research-oriented outputs."
